simple.summary: גְּמַר (gᵉmar) means perfect. First listed occurrence: Ezra 7 12.

definitions.full: H1585. gemar [ גְּמַר ] verb complete (often ᵑ7 Syriac; rare Biblical Hebrew); — Pe`al Passive participle גְּמִיר Ezra 7:12 as adjective perfect (read perhaps ג ׳שְׁלָם , Torrey Berthol; compare 5:7 ).
